The Memos timeline with a memo composer and recent memos
Other ways to run Memos, including Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and a plain binary, are in the deployment guide.

Releases are tagged `YY.MM.N`, with release candidates as `YY.MM.N-rc.K` and no `v` prefix. The Docker tag `stable` follows stable releases, a month tag such as `26.10` follows the newest stable release of that month, and `canary` follows development builds. Coming from a release before v0.31.0, run v0.31.0 once first; see the upgrade requirements.
- Web Clipper for Chrome and Firefox saves pages, selections, and images to your memos as Markdown with a link to the source.
- Memogram is a Telegram bot that saves your messages and images to Memos.
- The API and MCP server connect Memos to your own scripts and AI tools.
Questions go to the docs, Discord, or GitHub Discussions. Bugs and ideas go to issues. Code changes start with the contributing guide.
